beats: Demons ruled Darukavana by the sea
Supriya chanted Shiva's name in chains
Shiva blazed forth and freed them

beats.line: By the western sea, demons ruled the Daruka forest
Held captive, Supriya kept chanting Shiva's name
Shiva blazed forth as light and set his devotees free
He stays by the sea as Nageshwar, Lord of Serpents
